title: Delegation Log Entry
description: One entry per Agent tool event. Two entries per delegation: one 'dispatch' entry (from pre-delegation-validator.js via PreToolUse) and one 'completion' entry (from delegation-logger.js via PostToolUse). Join on taskHash to compute dispatch-to-completion latency.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC. Meaning depends on 'phase': dispatch entries record when Maestro sent the task; completion entries record when the subagent returned.

phase.description: Entry phase. 'dispatch': written by pre-delegation-validator.js at PreToolUse (before Agent tool executes). 'completion': written by delegation-logger.js at PostToolUse (after Agent tool returns). Absent in entries written before v3 item 4 — treat as 'completion' for backward compatibility.

taskHash.description: 12-char hex prefix of SHA256(prompt[0:200]). Correlation key: join dispatch and completion entries with matching taskHash to get per-task latency. Both hooks compute identical hashes from identical input. Collision probability negligible for typical session volumes.

sessionId.description: UUID from Claude Code session context. Groups all dispatches and completions in a session.

agentId.description: Subagent runtime ID. Only present in completion entries (PostToolUse). 'unknown' in practice — Claude Code does not expose subagent runtime ID in PostToolUse hook input for Agent calls. Absent in dispatch entries.

agentName.description: Resolved agent name. Extraction order: (1) tool_input.agent field, (2) known-agent list scan of prompt text, (3) 'unknown'. Available in both dispatch and completion entries.

taskSummary.description: First 120 chars of task prompt (completion) or first 200 chars (dispatch — pre-delegation-validator uses 200 for hash input). Used as human-readable context. Do not rely on exact match between dispatch and completion summaries.

examples.taskSummary: List all .js files in /Users/awesome/dev/devtest/Maestro/.claude/hooks/ with their line counts.
List all .js files in /Users/awesome/dev/devtest/Maestro/.claude/hooks/ with their line counts. Use wc -l on each file.

consumers: subagent-error-reporter.js — resolveAgentName() looks up agentId in completion entries
enforce-4d-evaluation.js — detectTaskFromDelegationLog() queries completion entries for recent Task dispatches
latency analysis — join dispatch + completion entries on taskHash, subtract timestamps
knownLimitations: agentId is always 'unknown' in completion entries — Claude Code PostToolUse does not expose subagent runtime ID for Agent calls
entries written before v3 item 4 lack 'phase' and 'taskHash' fields — treat as completion entries
taskSummary length differs between dispatch (200 chars) and completion (120 chars) — do not use as join key
hash collision possible but negligible for session-scale volumes (12-char hex = 281 trillion combinations)
